title: 二向箔 / Dimensional Strike
direction: A tiny, softly glowing slip of 'paper' drifts into the Solar System. Where it rests, three-dimensional space collapses into a flat plane that spreads without stopping; Neptune, Saturn, Earth and finally the Sun fall into it and spread out as vast, luminous, perfectly flat paintings - beautiful and final. This is an elegy, not a battle: no drums. Palette: felt-piano-like notes (soft attack, long decay) carrying a simple slow melody in A minor / A dorian; a wide slow string pad; glassy bell tones; and underneath, from 11s onward, a continuously descending Shepard tone (the feeling of endlessly falling). Each planet's fall is a soft swell that blooms and flattens. The Sun (43s) is the emotional peak: full pad, widest chord, then it thins to one held high note.

sections.name: title
sections.note: black screen title. A single high bell tone, long reverb.

sections.name: calm
sections.note: the serene Solar System; a small slip of light glides past. Sparse felt-piano melody, innocent.

sections.name: foil
sections.note: close on the foil; its glow fades and space around it begins to flatten. Melody stops on an unresolved note; the descending Shepard tone starts very quietly.

sections.name: neptune
sections.note: the plane's edge sweeps outward; Neptune falls and spreads into a flat blue disc. Pad enters; first swell.

sections.name: saturn
sections.note: Saturn and its rings flatten into immense concentric circles. Bigger swell, melody returns an octave higher.

sections.name: earth
sections.note: Earth and the Moon. The most intimate passage: the solo melody at its clearest over a warm pad; giant snowflakes bloom around the flat Earth (glassy bell arpeggio, like ice crystallising).

sections.name: sun
sections.note: the Sun falls and unrolls into a colossal swirling disc of fire, like The Starry Night. Emotional peak: full pad, widest voicing, deep sustained bass. Still no drums - weight comes from the low end.

sections.name: painting
sections.note: pull back from the finished flat painting of the whole system while fleeing. Harmony resolves, thinning out.

sections.name: endcard
sections.note: end card. One held high note and the last of the Shepard descent, fading to silence by 61.5s.
